source_text.ISS-0347: BadMapError crash in print_advisory/1 when lint_file/2's parse-error branch returned advisory: [] instead of the map shape print_advisory/1's dot-access expects. Fixed by normalizing the shape. See docs/issues/ISS-0347.yaml and lib/letflow/design/iss0347-lint-handoffs-advisory-shape.md.

task.description: TEST-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 4) for ISS-0347: write a regression test proving the BadMapError is fixed. Must be shown to FAIL against pre-fix code and PASS against post-fix code (docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md Steps 2-4's fail-then-pass rule).
acceptance_criteria: Test constructs (or uses a fixture) a handoff file that triggers lint_file/2's parse-error branch (e.g. a file with invalid JSON, or a UTF-8 BOM causing Jason.DecodeError) and asserts mix letflow.lint_handoffs / the underlying lint function does NOT raise BadMapError -- it completes and reports the parse error as a normal violation/advisory entry

Demonstrate fail-then-pass explicitly in the test spec: check out the pre-fix commit (parent of ELIXIR-DEV's fix commit, currently HEAD~N -- identify via git log), run the new test, confirm it FAILS (raises BadMapError); then confirm it PASSES on the current fix branch. Record both real outputs in test/specs/ISS-0347.md
No test depends on wall-clock time or unseeded randomness
Test is self-sufficient, doesn't depend on other tests running first, uses a temp/fixture file not a shared hardcoded path

result.summary: Added two regression tests to test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs (F-PARSE-ADVISORY-SHAPE, F-BOM-PARSE-ADVISORY-SHAPE) that reproduce print_advisory/1's exact dot-access pattern (r.advisory.warnings, size_info.desc_len/summary_len) against lint_file/2's parse-error branch output. Verified fail-then-pass in a throwaway git worktree at c30f672 (fix commit 07a766e's parent): both tests failed with the exact %BadMapError{term: []} pre-fix, and all 22 tests in the file (including the 2 new ones) pass on the feature branch post-fix. Full transcript in test/specs/ISS-0347.md. Worktree removed; working tree confirmed clean, no detached HEAD left.
